create_L21Loss_euclidean_distance: create an L21Loss instance to compute Euclidean distance between 3D point pairs with configurable reduction
build_Regr3D_3d_regression_loss: build a Regr3D loss module to supervise 3D point regression between two views with normalization
combine_MultiLoss_additive_losses: combine multiple MultiLoss instances using addition and multiplication operators to weight and chain losses
create_ConfLoss_confidence_weighted: create a ConfLoss module to weight pixel-level regression loss by learned per-pixel confidence values
build_Regr3DMultiview_multi_view_loss: build a Regr3DMultiview loss to supervise 3D point regression across multiple views with a common anchor
